{"title":"LMIA-exempt ICT (IMP) application comprehensive document checklist — plan","content":"## Objective
Produce a comprehensive, structured document checklist for a Canadian **LMIA-exempt Intra-Company Transferee (ICT)** work permit application, explicitly clarifying **which IRCC forms apply (e.g., IMM 1295 vs IMM 5710)** by application scenario, and listing **employer-side** documents (Employer Portal/offer of employment, compliance fee evidence, corporate relationship proof, role/compensation support).

## Strategy (two-axis)
- **Reduce uncertainty first** by pulling current requirements from authoritative IRCC pages (forms, guides, checklists, employer portal instructions, IMP employer compliance).
- Then **reduce remaining work** by synthesizing into a single MECE checklist with scenario-based form selection and a clean employer/employee split.

## Intended output structure
1) **Quick decision tree**: Inside Canada extension vs outside Canada vs port-of-entry eligibility → which form/package.
2) **Applicant forms & core documents** (with scenario-specific forms).
3) **Employer compliance package** (Employer Portal, IMP code, offer of employment, fee, supporting corporate docs).
4) **ICT eligibility evidence** (qualifying relationship, prior employment, position duties, specialized knowledge/manager/executive evidence).
5) **Common add-ons**: family members, biometrics, medical, police certs (if applicable), translations, digital photo, etc.

## Parallelization
Research can be safely parallelized across (A) applicant forms by scenario, (B) employer compliance docs, (C) ICT eligibility evidence.
